scope: Complete standalone application with real registered handlers. Test-local event/focus/task and modeled geometry adapters. No physical device, browser rendering, native keyboard presentation or audible output claim.

results.name: Exact alpha.4 sources and prior correction boundaries remain recoverable
Workspace adaptation is transient and bootstrap has no errors
Touch paints canonical volume data with one undo step for a stroke
Pen paints signed arpeggio values without affecting volume or notes
Scaled canvas coordinates select the correct canonical envelope point
A no-op touch does not create an undo snapshot or dirty the project
Captured drags clamp at envelope endpoints and value limits
Secondary pointers, right buttons, outside starts and zero-sized canvases are ignored
Missing instruments and empty envelopes remain guarded
A second pointer cancels the active stroke across canvases
Pointer cancellation stops further editing and preserves prior committed changes
Lost pointer capture releases the stroke
Window blur releases envelope input
Visibility loss releases envelope input
Tab changes release strokes and remove Audio layout state
Project replacement and undo cannot receive stale envelope writes
Instrument selection changes cannot redirect a stroke to another instrument
Touch compatibility mouse events cannot add a duplicate desktop stroke
Touch-event fallback paints and releases with the same undo contract
Touch fallback cancels on multi-touch or cancellation
Selected row and channel scroll into the modeled tracker viewport
Rendering an unchanged selection does not snap a manually scrolled tracker
Viewport resize and scroll update Audio height without project edits
Playback does not force tracker follow-scrolling
Touch envelope edits persist through canonical project save and reopen
Envelope input releases the native keyboard and does not press emulator buttons
